connect_uri.description: The libvirt connection URI to use. Corresponds to the --connect flag.

default_fork.description: If true, forces forking into background (--fork). Default is no-fork.

debug_mode.description: If true, enables debugging output to console (--debug).

startup_view.description: List of startup display modes. Each item is a map with 'type' and 'identifier'. Types: domain-creator, domain-editor, domain-performance, domain-console, host-summary, systray. Identifier required for editor/perf/console.
